scientific_integrity: Point counts are exhaustive exact finite-field arithmetic; odd-degree equality is proved for all odd extensions. No geometric isomorphism or independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Arithmetic census of the 42 smooth coefficient-marked equations over F_7 only. Not a census of unmarked genus-three curves, twists or all prime fields; the geometric Prym superspeciality and Deuring-polynomial stratification are prior work. Possible historical priority overlap with older finite-field isogeny tables or a reformulation of a hypergeometric count remains.
title: Thirteen Weil-polynomial classes and four Prym Frobenius types for cyclic quartics over \(\mathbb F_7\)
